1b1(rgyud): @##//rgya gar skad du/shrI TA kAr+N+Na pa ma hA yo gi nI tan+t+ra rA dza 
1b2(rgyud): nA ma|bod skad du/dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal 
1b3(rgyud): po chen po zhes bya ba/oM sangs rgyas dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 
1b4(rgyud): 'das gsung gi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa 
1b5(rgyud): dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo chen po'i dbang phyug/de bzhin 
2a1(rgyud): @##//gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpa' bo'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 
2a2(rgyud): b+ha ga rnams su rtsen pa dang ldan par gyur to//der dpa' bo chen po'i dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/bde ba chen 
2a3(rgyud): po'i ting 'dzin gyis//dbang po'i dra ba bdag gis mthong //'khor ba dang ni des 'byung gis//mya ngan 
2a4(rgyud): 'das pa so sor bskyed//de yi dbus su sku chen po//bdag gis dbang po yis rig go/dpa' bo rang gi rang bzhin 
2a5(rgyud): ni||ye shes rgya mtshor mnyan par gyis//rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo dbus su//phag mo bdag ni 'dri ba'o//dbang 
2a6(rgyud): po'i dra ba ci ru bshad//bdag gis gang du bshad par bya//mthong ba dang ni chen po'i sgra//bde ba zab de bzhin ci//
2b1(rgyud): ting 'dzin med cing de la ni//byung ba nyams par byas pa dang //'khor ba yang dang 'byung ba ni//gang du thim par 'gyur ba yin//bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i ming //
2b2(rgyud): ji ltar slar yang yongs su bskyed//sku brjod pa ni gsung par mdzod//nyid kyi dbang pos rig pa ni//bde ba chen por bzhugs gyur pa'i//bdag gis bdag pas gsung bar 
2b3(rgyud): mdzod//dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen pos bka' stsal pa/phag mo lha rdzas pad ma can//lha mo rtsa gcig yid kyis nyon//sngon du spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni//mdor bsdus pa yis 
2b4(rgyud): bshad par bya//dbang po'i 'jig rten mchog chos bshad//dra ba de la yid rol ba'o//bdag gi nga rgyal tsam gyis ni//dam tshig mchog gang byung ba'o//de phyir ye shes che mthong 
2b5(rgyud): ste||thabs chen bde la bzhugs pas so//gang du dbang po rnams kyis za//de yis nga yi ming sngon song //de tshe ting nge 'dzin tsam du//thub pa skyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs/
2b6(rgyud): yang dag lhag rtogs ye shes ni//sangs rgyas rnams kyi lha dbang pos//de rnams su byung ba'i sbyor bas//mkha' 'gro mchog mang gis byas so//bde dang mi bde gnyis nyams 
2b7(rgyud): las||slar yang 'dir ni byung ba ste//sgra yi gzugs las byung zhing 'thon//dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul lo//sems gsum rnams kyi dbye ba yis//grub mo khyod kyis 
2b8(rgyud): shes par gyis//'di yis rang byung bcom ldan 'das//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom//byung dang 'byung ba'i dus su ni//yongs su gsal ba 'ong gsal ba'o//de phyir 
3a1(rgyud): @#//'jig rten 'khor bar byed//de ni 'khor bar yongs su brjod//'dir ni sgyu ma skyes de bzhin//de ni thim pa'i dngos po'ang med//myang 'das gzhan pa'i rdzas yod yin//
3a2(rgyud): 'khor ba yi ni phyi rol son//srid pa'i rtse mo gang 'dzin pa//de phyir mya ngan 'das par brjod//gzugs ni sgyu ma lta bu'i sku//de yi gnas la rnam par 'phro//bdag chen ye shes gzugs 
3a3(rgyud): kyi ni//dbang pos gsal bar rig pa ste//lha dang sbyin byed la sogs pas//mi mthong mkha' la 'gro ba'i gzugs/lha khyod kyis ni gsung rnams kyi//ye shes chen po'i ros bdag tshim/
3a4(rgyud): de ring bdag la the tshom ma ches//dpa' bo rnams kyi rang bzhin ci//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa//dpa' rnams thams cad rang bzhin te//rang bzhin de rnams chos can no//'dir ni 
3a5(rgyud): 'dod pa'i dus brjod de//'dod pa sems las yongs su byung //'dod dang sems gnyis dag las ni//byung ba gzugs ni gtso bo'o//'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba//thog ma 
3a6(rgyud): dbus mthar yang dag gnas//gang zhig mtha' ma rnams kyi sems//sems de ro mnyam gyur pa'o//dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba las//mkha' 'gro de ni de phyir byung //rdo rje 
3a7(rgyud): mkha' 'gro bdag nyid che//sa gsum po ni bsgrub par bya//gang tshe sngon du yang dag byung //'gro ba'i gtso bo tshangs pa'o//gnas dang de bzhin ji ltar stong //mgon po sems 
3a8(rgyud): can rnams grol byed//de tshe 'jig rten khams gzhan gyis//chung ngu 'dir ni bskul ba'o//gson gson byang chub spros son pa'i//sems can bsgral ba'i sems med pa//sgyu 
3b1(rgyud): la'i rang bzhin khyod bzhugs nas//khams gsum ma lus bsgral bar mdzod//yon tan dag 'di thos nas ni//sems can grol byed 'di ltar bsgom//de bzhin gshegs pa kun rnam pa//
3b2(rgyud): 'gro ba'i gtso bo he ru ka/dpal ni sngon du mngon brjod pas//rten la sogs pa bskyed pa ste//glu dang rol mo dri za dang //gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams dang //'gro ba'i sde dang las dang 
3b3(rgyud): ni//de yi rgyun las yongs su byung //de la sogs pa mtha' med dang //stong phrag sum cu rtsa gsum mo//gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na//thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs//de nyid 
3b4(rgyud): rnam pa bcu drug dang //skye ba dang ni thim pa'i rgyu//rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i de nyid//zla ba'i dbye bas 'gro ba'o//dga' ba rtag tu shes byas nas//tshes gcig zla ba 'phel bas so//nag po 
3b5(rgyud): sogs dang dkar mthar yang //thung ngu de bzhin 'dir shes bya//'di skad thos pa bdag gi dag/gsang ba'i 'dod pa thams cad ster//de bzhin 'dir bdag the tshom mchis//gsang ba 
3b6(rgyud): la sogs gsung ni ci//bdag gi bdag pos gsung bar mdzod//sems can rnams kyi don byed pa//lha mo chen mo bdag dga'o//sems can kun gyi dgos pa'i rgyur//
3b7(rgyud): mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad bya ste//rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis nyon//gsang ba khams thams cad kyi mtha'//dbang po'i gnas ni mchog yin la//rnam shes phun tshogs de 
3b8(rgyud): rnams su//dgyes pa nam mkha' las byung ba'o//thams cad bdag nyid khams gsum gyi//khyab bya'i gzugs su yang dag son//rtag bzhugs gnyis su med pa'i chos//sgyu ma 
4a1(rgyud): @#//rmi lam lta bu mchog/yang na bdag med bcu drug dang //khyad par du yang snying rje'o//de yi rnam pa ye shes che//de kho na nyid kun du son//'dir ni skye bar ko bya ba//
4a2(rgyud): rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor ro//thim pa sgrub pa gnyis dang ni//de bzhin bsnyen pa gnyis kyang ngo//rnal 'byor thig ler bshad pa ste//phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'o//dus kyis 
4a3(rgyud): phye dang zla ba yi//rdzogs ldan gsum gnyis rtsed du son//'di yi rdo rje'i zhal bzhi po//dga' ba brgyad gnyis su 'gyur te//cha shas bcu drug ldan pa yi//phyogs kyi dbye bas 'gro ba'o//
4a4(rgyud): thung du nyi ma'i rgyu ba yis//de bzhin du ni cha shas za//bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya//gnyis med ye shes bla na med//byang chub sems 'od chen por ni//rnal 'byor chen po nges par 'gro//stong 
4a5(rgyud): nyid snying rje dbyer med do//dngos rnams nam mkha'i me tog bzhin//sad pa na yang nyams pa ste//de gnas kun tu gnas min pa'o//rmi lam yul med las byung ba//dbang po kun las 
4a6(rgyud): byung ba med//gnyid log pa yi stobs kyis ni//sa gsum po ni bza' bar bya//gnyid mthug skyes pa'i dus de ltar//sad med gnyid med rmi lam med//'das pa'i bde ba'i dus 
4a7(rgyud): rnams su//sangs rgyas nyid kyang lag khar gnas//mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni//rdo rje mkha' 'gro mchog tu bde//las kyi yul ni bsten byas na//sum cu rtsa gsum du 
4a8(rgyud): ltung ngo//ma rig pas slad nges par ni//'gro ba dmyal sogs 'jigs pa che//de phyir sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun//rdzu 'phrul che 'dir rjes chags bya//ji ltar bcom ldan 'das 
4b1(rgyud): bdag po//mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi ni ming //de ni bdag la sems pas gsungs//mkha' 'gro kun la bdag mchog tu//gsang ba der ni btung byas nas//phag mo lha rdzas rnal 'byor ma//gnyis 
4b2(rgyud): med tshig gis ji ltar zhes//de bzhin yang nas yang du dris//mkha' 'gro ma'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa//phra mo'i rnam pa rtsa gsum ste//rnam par shes pa gsum gyi rgyu//de phyir phra mor rig 
4b3(rgyud): bya ste||rtsa 'byung ba ni bdag nyin che//sum cu rtsa bdun rnal 'byor ma//re re la ni de yongs ldan//mkha' 'gro ma kun der bshad de//gzhan yang de ltar ngo mtshar che//ming mdor bstan 
4b4(rgyud): pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir//de kun ji lta bzhin bshad bya//zla ba 'o ma snum pa mo//'jam ma'o dang kun sbyin ma//ma dang sring mo bu mo dang //sring mo'i bu mo ni ne mo//gnyen mo pa yi ma dang ni//zhang po yi 
4b5(rgyud): yang chung ma dang //pad can dung can sna tshogs ma//glang po pa dang myos brlams ma//gzugs ma sgra ma dri ma dang //ro ma reg ma yid ma dang //chos dbyings ma dang tshogs can ma//gnyid 
4b6(rgyud): ma le lo ma gzhan gnon//rlom pa mo dang sgeg mo dang //bzang zhal ma dang drag mo ma//'thung ma za ma 'jigs pa mo//ha ha sgrogs ma dur khrod ma//bcom ldan dgyes mar rtag tu bshad//
4b7(rgyud): sum cu rtsa bdun rnal 'byor ma/las kyi chos gang blangs pa yis//gzhan gyi ming yang shes par bya//gang zhig gang gis mngon brjod pa'i//rtsa de 'dir ni brjod pa'o//de rnams sems 
4b8(rgyud): dpa' bde rang bzhin//mthar gyur mchog tu zhi ba'o//rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos po yang //mchog tu zag med rnal 'byor ldan//mdog dang phyag sogs rnam pa ru//srid pa'i 'khor lor 
5a1(rgyud): @#//yang dag byung //gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs 'dir//pul+lir sogs dbus su'o//gang zhig gang gi lha'i bdag po//de ni de dang ngas rgyas gdab//nyid dang bdag tu 
5a2(rgyud): rtsen gyur pa'i//bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan//'di yis rang byung bcom ldan 'das//gcig pu de bzhin dang po'i lha//mkha' 'gro ma kun bde ster ba'i//bcom ldan rdo rje 'di gsungs 
5a3(rgyud): so||nam mkha'i thog mtha ma med//gang 'drar mchog tu 'du shes pa//de 'drar bdag ni rig pa ste//snang med par yang yongs su gsal//der ni 'byung ba'ang yod min te//'jig rten 
5a4(rgyud): pa yi tha snyad mchog/ji ltar mkha' las mi byung ba//bla med mi 'dir de bzhin no//ro bro ba ni gcig dngos la//de yi nang na dngos mang po//gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin 'dis//thams cad 
5a5(rgyud): ro ste ro'i khyab bdag/pho nya rnams kyi bdag po yis//sa gsum po ni mchog tu za//thabs dang shes rab snying rje che//lha'i bdag po gzhan med do//'dod chags ma yin chags bral 
5a6(rgyud): min||dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so//de ltar brtag shes rnal 'byor pas//'dod bya kun la longs spyod bya//rtag tu nang du gyur byas nas//kha dog rnams ni zhal las byung //rtag tu 
5a7(rgyud): lus kyis sbyin pa ste//sems las byung ba spang bar bya//de ltar 'dod chags sgyu mtha' la//rol pa mchog gi go 'phang ngo//'dod chags bral ba dga' ba gsum//spangs pa dbu ma zag 
5a8(rgyud): pa med//gzung bar bya ba min pa ste//dngos po'i rang bzhin 'dod chags min//brel ba'i dga' ba nyams pa ste//de la'ang dga' bar mi bya'o//de gnyis dbus na gnas pa yis//chos de 
5b1(rgyud): la yang dga' dmigs med//dbye ba med pa yi ni chos//rdo rje la ni dga' bar gyis//lha'i rnam pa'i rnal 'byor bdag/skad cig dngos sum byed pa'o//lugs ma la sogs rnal 'byor gyis//rnam par 
5b2(rgyud): byas pa'i dbyibs su 'gyur//stong nyid rang bzhin gzugs rnal 'byor//rang byin brlab pa'i mtshan nyid do//bdag byin brlab dang bral rnal 'byor//spun lkogs dum bu bzhin shes bya//
5b3(rgyud): 'di 'dra'i mtshan nyid mchog gyur pa//skye bo phyugs rnams kyis mi shes//de phyir sgyu 'phrul 'di bsgoms na//byang chub bla na med pa thob//skye ba 'di la glen pa nyid//shes rab snyan dngags 
5b4(rgyud): skyes bur 'gyur//'di 'dra'i yon tan tshogs ldan pas//rmi lam dang ni mnyam par ltos//rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du//'gro ste de phyir 'jig rten pa'o//mngon sum rang nyid sngags kyi sku//
5b5(rgyud): 'khor lo gsum rnams nyis 'gyur ro//gcig la 'khor lo gsum bshad de//gnyis pa nyis 'gyur du ni 'dod//'khor lo gsum po thabs shes rab//snyoms par 'jug par 'chang ba'o//
5b6(rgyud): de ni nyis 'gyur shes bya ste//'khor lo nyis 'gyur des bshad do//khams gsum gyis ni gnas chen po//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa'o//dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba//rdo rje sems 
5b7(rgyud): dpa' bde ba'i mchog/de bzhin gshegs pa gang dbang che//bcom ldan rdo rje 'di gsungs so//chos dang chos min gang du nub//byang chub der ni sems gzung gis//grub pa lha dang lha ma yin//
5b8(rgyud): dbang po dang ni yul dang ni//khams dang skye mched thams cad ni//skye ba dang ni 'gag pa ste//rmongs pa 'ching zhing mkhas pa ni//yongs su shes pas grol ba'o//sems 'di rang nyid mngon sum du 
6a1(rgyud): @#//khams gsum du ni rnam par gnas//bdag dang mchog khyod gnyis med las//tshogs pa'i gtso bo byung ba'o//spyod lam la sogs bye brag chos//mdo sde rnam shes 
6a2(rgyud): dbu ma pa//mos pa'i sems can rnams bshad de//bden pa ma yin rdzun pa min//phyag ni bcu gnyis dang ldan te//de bzhin zhal ni bzhi pa'o//kha dog nam mkha' sngon po la//spyan 
6a3(rgyud): gsum brkyang bskum ldan pa ste//'phrog byed dkar mo mnyam par mnan//gzhan ni 'bum tsho stong phrag gi/gang dang gang gi rgyud kyi ni//phyi dang gsang ba nang bdag nyid//de dang de yi gzugs 
6a4(rgyud): nges par//lha ni he ru ka'i bdag nyid//rgyud dang rgyud kyi nang mchog tu//dbye ba mos pa'i dbang gis te//ming ni de 'drar shes par bya//'on kyang he ru ka bsres pa'o//kha dog de dang 'drar shes 
6a5(rgyud): bya//bzhugs tshul he ru ka'i rnam pa//sa ni bcu gnyis rnams kyi rgyu//de yis he ru ka dang 'dra//rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs//dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba//rdo rje sems 
6a6(rgyud): dpa' bde ba'i mchog/bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so//dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa ste 'di ni 
6a7(rgyud): la'u dang po'o////phag mo lha rdzas rnam 'byor mas//slar yang rdo rje mchod byas te//bcom ldan bdag pos bstan par mdzod//phag mo ci yis yongs su byung //bskyed pa 
6a8(rgyud): gang gis bskyed pa yin//rang bzhin ji ltar du ni 'dod//bdag byung ba yi rgyu mtshan ci//'dir ni dgos pa ji ltar yin//dbang po dang ni yul thams cad//lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du rab 
6b1(rgyud): zhugs//spyi bo'i rdo rje gur du ni//steng du kha bltas rlung 'bab po//'dod chags nyi ma'i dbus su ni//skad cig gis ni sprul thim gyur//der skyes pa yi phag mo ni//b+ha ga ling ga yid las byung //
6b2(rgyud): bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin khams//de rnams las ni sngon du skyes//rang bzhin bdag med gcig pu ste//mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no//rgyu mtshan skye bo sgrol ba dang //snying rje'i gzugs 
6b3(rgyud): rang bzhin du byung //'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rig ste//phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sgrub pa'o//khyod ni lha mo'i bdag po ste//kun du spyod pa mang spyod pa'o//sngags kyi phreng ba brje byas nas//a yig la sogs 
6b4(rgyud): de'i khyab bdag/yang na phag mo'i rtsa ba dang //go cha'i sngags rnams kyis ldan te//yi ge re re'i sngags kyi ni//spyod pa sdom par son pa'o//rnal 'byor ma mchog skye ba ni//rtsa yi mchog gi grong du ste//stong 
6b5(rgyud): phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi//dbus ma a ba d+hu ti'o//dbu ma 'di ltar thams cad kyi//khyab byed du ni rnam par gnas//de phyir phag mo gtso mo yi//gong 'phang mchog bzhin shes par bya//rdo rje la sogs 
6b6(rgyud): ming thog mar//a rdo rje dang ka rdo rje//sngags mthar de la sogs pa ste//yang na so so tha dad du'o//gang gis dus su sngags zlos pa//de'i dus rnams su rnal 'byor ldan//lte ba spyi bo snying gyen du//'di ltar 'gro dang 
6b7(rgyud): 'ong ba med//dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gtso mo//de ni bdag nyid rnam par 'phro//rang gi 'khor ldan rnal 'byor ma//zhing dang zhing rnams su ni 'gro//lha mo khyod ni bdag po ste//nga dang lhan cig kha sbyor ro//dus dang dus 
6b8(rgyud): ris yin par//nam mkha'i bu ga'i nang 'dug nas//de bzhin skye gnas lam 'thon nas//'chi ba med pa'i sa bon 'dzag/der mi 'pho ming ye shes bya//hig phyed yi ges bsgom bya ste//mi mo 
7a1(rgyud): @#//skyes bu'i dus su yang //mchog tu zag med mngon par bya//de byung ba yi rig ma che//bsgom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bri'o//thog mar rnam snang mgon po ste//ri mo sum skor lte 'og 
7a2(rgyud): gnas//langs nas mgrin pa'i bar du 'gro//sa gsum sgron ma lta bur son//gzhan pa'i bsngags ni sa mtha' 'dra//de las zla 'bab g.yon nas so//sngags 'di thig les brgyan pa ste//sngags 
7a3(rgyud): ni rnal 'byor ma bskyed pa'o//slar yang sa bon gnyis pa brjod//g.yas pa nyi ma bskyed pa ste//logs su gnyis phyi mgor thig le//ya sde'i mtha' yi sa bon ni//byang chub sems chen 'bab lam mo//'di 
7a4(rgyud): ni phag mo'i sa bon yin//A yi yi ges mthas brgyan pa//bcu drug zla phyed nyi mas brgyan//ya sde'i dang po'i sa bon ni//sbyor bas sa gsum rlung yon tan//dbyangs kyi bcu gsum pas rgyas gdab//
7a5(rgyud): dkar po'i phyogs kyis mgo bor brgyan//thig le dang ni bcas pa 'bar//dga' ba bzhi po dag pa'o//pa'i sde'i mtha' ma bde ba'i gzugs//oM yi yi ge zhon ldan pa//mgo bor zla phyed nyi mas mnan//
7a6(rgyud): sa yi pha rol gzhom med pas//nyi ma yi ni gdan la gnas//dbyangs kyi bzhi ban drung bzung //mgo bor zla phyed thig les brgyan//'dod chags mtha' yi rang bzhin no//ye shes sa bon nyis 'gyur dbye//
7a7(rgyud): spro ba dang ni bsdu bas skyes//'og dang steng du gnas pa yi//mgon po longs spyod rdzogs 'dzin pa//snying ga dang ni chu skyes su//don gyi cho ga yongs rdzogs pa'o//yongs su skrag byed ma sa bon//ba mtha'i 
7a8(rgyud): yi ge bzung nas ni//slar yang de bzhin brjod par bya//o rgyan 'bar ba 'dzin grong gi/bu gar gtum mo sbor ba'o//byang chub sems kyis sa gsum 'gengs//de ltar bshad pa'i sngags gang ni//
7b1(rgyud): rim pas yi ge rnams mi mthun//rnal 'byor ma'i ming ldan par//las dus de ltar rtog par bya//re re'i che ba'i bdag nyid ni//yi ge yi ni grangs kyis so//bdag nyid chen po rnam par 'phro//byang chub cha shas cha 
7b2(rgyud): rgyu'o//thog mar rnam snang phyag 'tshal ba//chos kyi dbyings ni bya ba'i gzugs//ta sde'i lnga pa'i yi ge ni//lnga pa yi ni sde tshan no//rnal 'byor ma gzugs nam mkha' brten//ba mtha'i sa bon o dbyangs 
7b3(rgyud): ldan//gti mug 'joms par byed ma ste//rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs spro ba'o//de yi bzhi ba'i sa bon no//sa gsum du ni khyab pa yi//rnal 'byor ma ni spro ba'o//thog ma'i sde yi gsum pa ste//'gro ba drug po nyams 
7b4(rgyud): byed pa'i//mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor lo spro//ya sde'i mtha' ma'i sa bon ni//byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin na//lnga pa'i sde yi thog ma ste//de bzhin nyid kyi sa bon te//i yi dbyangs kyis mgo la reg/chu yi yi ge 
7b5(rgyud): yongs bsags pa//thams cad byed pa'i rang bzhin no//rtsa sde'i dbus gnas bzung nas ni//nyi ma yi ni gdan ldan pa//las kyi dus su khyad par ldan//phag mo yi ni sa bon ni//a yi yi ge rna bar reg/sa 
7b6(rgyud): gsum ye shes rang bzhin mnyam//me yi sa bon dbyangs gnyis ldan//'khor ba'i las kyi rang bzhin no//sa mtha'i mgo la I dbyangs reg/rtag tu tshangs pa'i rang bzhin blta//dbyangs kyi gnyis pa gzung 
7b7(rgyud): nas ni//de ltar mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs//sems can sgrol bar byed pa'o//ya yig gnas par dang ldan//slar yang I yi dbyangs sbyar ro//khams gsum rnal 'byor ma spro'o//drug pa'i sde yi dang po ni//

8a1(rgyud): @#//yongs ldan pa'o//so yi sa bon rna ba la//i yi dbyangs kyis reg pas dbye//klu yi sngags ni sbyar byas te//tre yi yi ge sa gsum kun//ye shes kyi ni khyad par sngags//la yi yi ge

13a1(rgyud): @#//mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags 'chi ba dang //skye ba yi ni rang bzhin no//gnyis med rnam pa'i chos las ni//gnyis su sems can 'dzin pa ste//shes rab la ni bde ster pa//bcom ldan bla
